title: Great Eastern Women's Run 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Great Eastern Women's Run 2026 Review | Singapore
meta_description: Great Eastern Women's Run review: 12,000+ women at the Singapore Sports Hub in November 2025, a sold-out half, S$305,000 raised, and a new tertiary category.
dek: Singapore's women-only race drew more than 12,000 runners for its 19th edition in November 2025, and sold out by August. Here is what that edition was like, ahead of 2026.
verdict: The Great Eastern Women's Run is Singapore's big women-only race, and it is popular: the 19th edition, in November 2025, was fully subscribed by early August and drew more than 12,000 women [1]. Categories ran from the elite half marathon and 10 km to a 2 km Mummy and Me run and a 100 m Princess Dash [1]. The race raised S$305,000 for Daughters of Tomorrow and the Singapore Cancer Society [1], and Goh Shing Ling won the elite half in 1:22:10 [1]. If you want a friendly, well-supported women's race in Singapore, enter early.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: More than 12,000 women took part in the 19th Great Eastern Women's Run at the Singapore Sports Hub [1]. The race was fully subscribed by early August [1].
Categories ran from the 21.1 km and 10 km to the family-friendly 2 km Mummy and Me and a 100 m Princess Dash [1]. A new competitive 10 km tertiary category drew 11 teams from five institutions [1].

sections.heading: A Race With a Cause
paragraphs: The event raised S$305,000 for two beneficiaries: Daughters of Tomorrow, which supports employability programmes for underprivileged women, and the Singapore Cancer Society, for recovery programmes for cancer survivors [1].
A member of the winning tertiary team said the energy and unity of women of all ages running together was amazing [1].

sections.heading: The Front of the Race
paragraphs: Goh Shing Ling, the previous year's runner-up, won the elite 21.1 km in 1:22:10 [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a women-only race with a big, supportive field and a cause attached, or a race you can run with your children.
Register as soon as entries open. The 2025 race sold out by early August, three months before race day.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 edition, including a participant's comment. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people run the Great Eastern Women's Run?
faqs.answer: More than 12,000 women took part in the 19th edition in November 2025 at the Singapore Sports Hub. The race was fully subscribed by early August, so places go well before race day.

faqs.question: What distances does the Great Eastern Women's Run offer?
faqs.answer: In 2025: an elite and open 21.1 km, a 10 km, a new competitive 10 km tertiary category for students, a 2 km Mummy and Me run and a 100 m Princess Dash for young girls.

faqs.question: What does the Great Eastern Women's Run raise money for?
faqs.answer: In 2025 it raised S$305,000 for Daughters of Tomorrow, which helps underprivileged women into work, and for the Singapore Cancer Society's recovery programmes for cancer survivors.
